title: The PLA Watch: Scarborough Shoal, July 1st Loyalty, and What Routine Looks Like
dek: Southern Theater Command described a month of joint naval and air activity around Huangyan Island as combat readiness patrols. The rest of the week showed how the PLA turns Party anniversaries into institutional instruction.
signal: Southern Theater Command recast June activity around Scarborough Shoal as sustained joint combat readiness patrols, placing the operation above the language of a routine exercise or coast guard presence.
